# Verglas

> Verglas is the trust layer for agent money on Avalanche: a rule-bound,
> non-custodial vault for AI agents, zero-knowledge proofs that a whole
> spending window obeyed the owner's rules, and attestations that travel to
> every Avalanche L1 over native Interchain Messaging (ICM). Live on
> Avalanche C-Chain mainnet (real Circle USDC, on-chain Groth16 proofs) and
> on Fuji testnet, where the ICM crossing to the Echo L1 runs end to end.

Key facts:
- Category: AI-agent trust & treasury infrastructure on Avalanche (C-Chain + sovereign L1s)
- The vault (VerglasAccount): payee whitelist, per-transaction limit, rolling 24h daily cap, lifetime budget and an owner freeze — the rule engine lives in the contract, refusals come back by name, and every spend folds into a Poseidon hash chain
- The receipt: a Groth16 zk-SNARK (~86k constraints) proves every payment obeyed the rules without revealing a single transaction; verified on-chain for ~287k gas
- The stamp: Verglas wrote the first ZK-verified validation response on the ERC-8004 Validation Registry on Avalanche — live on both C-Chain mainnet and Fuji
- The passport: attestations cross to any Avalanche L1 over ICM; the receiving gate answers one view call — isCleared(agentId)
- verglas-pay: an MCP server on npm (npx verglas-mcp) that gives Claude or any LLM agent four tools — status, pay, pay over x402, check — holding only the rotatable agent key, never the owner's
- x402 buying: the agent can buy from any x402-gated API; its payment float refills exclusively through the vault, so budget, limits and the freeze govern x402 spending too — a frozen vault stops an x402 payment with a named on-chain refusal
- Agent identities are real ERC-721 tokens on the canonical ERC-8004 Identity Registry (mainnet agent #1783; Fuji agents #219 demo, #220 treasurer, #222 first user vault, #223 x402 float)
- Verglas Treasurer (first vertical): an autonomous corporate treasury agent that pays FX-timed supplier invoices inside an owner-adjustable calendar-day cap and a USD/TRY circuit breaker, backtested at 3.79% savings over 254 days of real USD/TRY data
- Owner console at /app: live vault status, the freeze lever, budget top-up, proof receipts and the interchain passport; installable as a PWA
- Positioning: spend limits are commodity — the proof is the product. Open standard (ERC-8004) + rules that live only in the contract + publicly verifiable compliance + trust that travels; not a walled platform score, not a backend policy engine

## Docs

- [Overview](https://verglas.xyz/docs/): what Verglas is and why it exists
- [Quickstart](https://verglas.xyz/docs/quickstart.html): give your agent a vault in ten minutes, test USDC included
- [Architecture](https://verglas.xyz/docs/architecture.html): hub, gate, vault and the registries
- [Proof system](https://verglas.xyz/docs/proofs.html): Poseidon commitment chain and the Groth16 circuit
- [verglas-pay (MCP)](https://verglas.xyz/docs/mcp.html): the vault as tools for any LLM agent
- [x402](https://verglas.xyz/docs/x402.html): let your agent buy things — under the vault's rules
- [Contracts](https://verglas.xyz/docs/contracts.html): deployed addresses on mainnet, Fuji C-Chain and the Echo L1
- [Treasurer](https://verglas.xyz/docs/treasurer.html): the corporate treasury vertical
- [SDK](https://verglas.xyz/docs/sdk.html): TypeScript SDK built on viem
- [Demo runbook](https://verglas.xyz/docs/demo.html): the live end-to-end flow
